name: Scent antenna
description: Tapered feeler rooted at the origin, curving up and forward (+x), tipped with a sensing nub. The hive reads the world with these instead of eyes — which is why nothing in the enemy roster has any. Deliberately unlit: in this world a glow means emission, never sensing, so only organs light up and an antenna can never be mistaken for an eye.

dead.description: A survivor's antenna — intact, but nothing on the air to read.
